subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — onboarding & deprovisioning artifacts (AcmeHealth)
messages:
From: Evan Torres <evan.torres@ridgewater-audit.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security-requests@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding & deprovisioning evidence for SOC 2 — AcmeHealth

Jordan —

Ridgewater is starting the SOC 2 fieldwork for AcmeHealth next week. As part of scoping we need the following artifacts related to employee lifecycle controls (for a representative sample of hires and leavers from the last 12 months):

- Pre-employment screening matrix (vendor, checks performed, sample IDs)
- Redacted background check copies for 6 employees (name redacted to initials)
- Onboarding training completion logs (security & privacy modules)
- Deprovisioning / termination playbook and recent runbook execution evidence (timestamps, ticket IDs)
- Any system access revocation snapshots (IAM logs or screenshots)

Can you confirm availability and an ETA for delivery? If there are redaction rules we should follow, please call those out. We prefer a Drive folder link and a checksum or delivery manifest.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Torres
Senior IT Audit Manager | Ridgewater Audit
evan.torres@ridgewater-audit.com

Action: Laura — flag any legal/RD issues if redaction needs help.

-Jordan
